summary.headline: Jupiter’s Combustion Omens
summary.text: Astrological omens for the combustion of Jupiter in the earthy and airy triplicities, including predictions about rulers, Khorasan, Arabia, weather, crops, food prices, markets, warfare, illness, travelers, and social groups. The passage distinguishes effects when Saturn, Mars, Venus, Mercury, or the Moon is placed in or aspects the configuration.
